verdict.rationale: The evidence shows merchants have their own Dashboard, where they manage disputes and subscriptions. It also mentions a white-label "reporting console" and API batch close described as aiding reconciliation, so some seller-facing money visibility exists. But nothing documents per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeper-ready exports; the payouts doc only covers viewing payout speed. Missing for 10: per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports tying payouts to transactions, CSV/accounting exports, evidence that sellers can close the month without ops help, independent corroboration.
